## Kimi K2.6 E2EE API

Kimi K2.6 E2EE is a large language model by Moonshot AI, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-kimi-k2-6`. It is end-to-end encrypted. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [Kimi K2.6](/models/kimi-k2-6).

Kimi K2.6 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). MoonshotAI's multimodal model with 262K context. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

### Kimi K2.6 E2EE API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2ee-kimi-k2-6` | E2EE | E2EE | $0.87 / $4.12 per 1M |

### Kimi K2.6 E2EE specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Moonshot AI |
| Released | Sep 6, 2026 |
| Privacy | E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 256K tokens |
| Max output | 8K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Kimi K2.6 E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-kimi-k2-6"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-kimi-k2-6",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
